# MatrixQR Blog
> The official technical blog of MatrixQR — a privacy-first, client-side QR code generator. We publish deep dives on offline QR generation, WiFi/vCard security, and privacy-by-design tooling.

## Technical Guides
- [The Pros and Cons of Static QR Codes](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/The-pros-and-cons-of-static-QR-codes)
- [How to Create an International vCard QR Code for Apple Wallet](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/vcard-qr-setup)

- privacy-focused QR tools

- WiFi QR code security
